fields.headline: MERIDIAN-4 entered safe mode during a geomagnetic storm

details.label: Observed
details.value: Autonomous fault protection after a rise in memory errors

details.label: Space weather context
details.value: Kp 8 (G4) observed at 2330 UTC; cause not yet determined

details.label: Status
details.value: Stable in safe mode; recovery plan under review

fields.customerImpact: Broadband service in the northern beam is interrupted. Southern beams are not affected.
fields.nextUpdate: The next update will be issued by 2026 Nov 07 0200 UTC.
fields.footer: Exercise notice. The operator and spacecraft are fictional.
